answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) can understand instructions, plan, and predict structured outputs, serving as backbones for such agents.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating sequences of actions (e.g., click, type, select) on web interfaces to complete user-specified tasks, based on natural language instructions and multimodal inputs (HTML and visual snapshots).

answer_2.quote: we compute granular metrics: the accuracy of predicting the correct HTML element (Ele. Acc.) to act on; the F1 score of predicting the correct operation (Op. F1) such as click, select, type; the percentage of successful steps (Step SR)... and the percentage of successful tasks (Overall SR)
